Only the middle horizontal row has zero endpoints and is described as short exact. The outer rows have no endpoint or exactness annotations; their exactness is left for the implication/converse discussed in step 2.1.

u_B a_1=a_2 u_A and u_C b_1=b_2 u_B compare maps A_1→B_2 and B_1→C_2; v_B a_2=a_3 v_A and v_C b_2=b_3 v_B compare maps A_2→B_3 and B_2→C_3. All four equalities are exactly the commutativity assumed in Given. Squares incident with zero objects commute by uniqueness of zero maps.
